// Browser walkthrough start state (generated by the W6 working-tree code, journaled commands only):
// v7 world w1, stone axe, finished workbench and log store, a stone pickaxe crafted and equipped,
// 6 stones and 2 branches dropped near the spawn (for the smelter), standing at the spawn. Nothing mined, no deposit discovered.
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { BrowserSaveStore, KeyValueStorage } from '../../../Astrix/Game/src/app/persistence';
import { GENERATOR_V2, WILDERNESS } from '../../../Astrix/Game/src/sim/world';
import { siteSpotOf } from '../../../Astrix/Game/src/sim/wild-build';
import { carriedWeight } from '../../../Astrix/Game/src/sim/gathering';
import { SPAWN, axe, build, dm, gather, load, ok, send, tick } from '../../../Astrix/Game/tests/w4-harness';
class MemoryStorage implements KeyValueStorage {
  readonly map = new Map<string, string>();
  getItem(k: string) { return this.map.get(k) ?? null; }
  setItem(k: string, v: string) { this.map.set(k, v); }
  removeItem(k: string) { this.map.delete(k); }
  key(i: number) { return [...this.map.keys()][i] ?? null; }
  get length() { return this.map.size; }
}
const storage = new MemoryStorage();
const store = new BrowserSaveStore(storage, 1337, GENERATOR_V2, { scenario: WILDERNESS, id: 'w1' });
const l = store.load(); if (l.status !== 'new') throw new Error(l.status);
const s = l.session;
load(s); tick(s, 2);
ok(send(s, { type: 'explore', at: dm(SPAWN) }));
axe(s);
const bench = build(s, 'workbench', { x: SPAWN.x - 10, z: SPAWN.z + 2 });
const logStore = build(s, 'log_store', { x: SPAWN.x - 4, z: SPAWN.z + 12 });
gather(s, 'branch', 1); gather(s, 'loose_stone', 2); gather(s, 'fiber_plant', 2);
ok(send(s, { type: 'craft', recipe: 'cord' }));
ok(send(s, { type: 'craft', recipe: 'stone_pickaxe', at: dm(siteSpotOf(s.world.wild!.build!.sites.get(bench)!)) }));
ok(send(s, { type: 'equip', item: 'stone_pickaxe' }));
const w = s.world.wild!;
for (const [k, n] of Object.entries(w.items)) ok(send(s, { type: 'drop', item: k, n, at: dm({ x: SPAWN.x - 30, z: SPAWN.z + 30 }) }));
gather(s, 'loose_stone', 6); gather(s, 'branch', 2);
const stage = { x: SPAWN.x + 6, z: SPAWN.z + 6 };
ok(send(s, { type: 'drop', item: 'stone', n: 6, at: dm(stage) }));
ok(send(s, { type: 'drop', item: 'branch', n: 2, at: dm(stage) }));
ok(send(s, { type: 'explore', at: dm(SPAWN) }));
tick(s, 2);
const res = store.save(s); if (!res.ok) throw new Error('save');
const key = [...storage.map.keys()].find((k) => k.startsWith('astrix:wild:'))!;
const avatarKey = 'astrix:avatar:v1:seed:1337:gen:2:world:w1';
const avatar = { x: SPAWN.x, y: 0, z: SPAWN.z, heading: 0, health: 100, stamina: 1, safe: { x: SPAWN.x, y: 0, z: SPAWN.z } };
writeFileSync('save.json', JSON.stringify({ key, record: storage.getItem(key), avatarKey, avatar, bench, logStore, stage, hash: s.stateHash }));
console.log('saved', key, 'entries', s.journal.entries.length, 'hash', s.stateHash, 'bag', JSON.stringify(w.items), carriedWeight(w), 'tools', JSON.stringify(w.tools), 'deposits', [...w.map!.deposits], 'sites', bench, logStore, 'last', JSON.stringify(w.map!.last));
